title: Dead Shopify product images on 15 product pages (2026-10-17 browser sweep)
capturedWith: npx convex data products|productGroups|productPlates|productKits --prod --format jsonl (read-only); HEAD of every products.imageUrl; Shopify Admin GraphQL 2025-01 productVariant media (read-only); live page og:image + Product JSON-LD
field: products.imageUrl (the old value is kept in products.legacyShopifyImageUrl, as convex/productPlates.ts promotePlateImagery does)
whereTheDeadUrlShows: products.imageUrl of the page's primary variant feeds og:image, the Product JSON-LD image, the photo fallback and gallery (a /_next/image request that 404s). productGroups.heroImageUrl is empty on all 15 groups, and no product on these pages has imageUrlCapOff.
sourcePriority: 1. Shopify's current media for the variant: none exists for any of the 44 variants (variant image, variant media and product media all empty).
2. The SKU's own plate in productPlates: 43 of 44. Each is a distinct file built from that SKU's master PSD or its own old-site photo; none is shared or borrowed.
3. Legacy www.bestbottles.com photo: used only as an identity reference on the contact sheet; the product page filters these URLs out, so it is not written.
